value.body: Reporting analysts build the regular reports and dashboards a business uses to track sales, operations or finance. They work in companies, shared-service centres and analytics teams, spending the day pulling data, cleaning it, updating dashboards and answering questions about the numbers.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: BBA, B.Com, BCA or B.Sc, often with an analytics certificate

items.label: Common tools
items.value: Excel, SQL, Power BI or Tableau

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers often enter as MIS executives or junior analysts in shared-service and analytics firms, where strong Excel is the main screening skill. Learning SQL and one dashboard tool, and showing a small portfolio of reports, makes applications more concrete.

value.title: Skills you'll use
items: Writing SQL queries to pull data
Building dashboards in Power BI or Tableau
Checking data for errors and inconsistencies

value.title: At a glance
items: Much of the work is recurring weekly and monthly reporting.
Common next steps: data analyst, business analyst or BI developer.
Automation tools are reducing purely manual report-making, so query and dashboard skills matter more.
